Russian Oligarch Offers Ex-Wife 1% of Divorce Settlement

A Russian oligarch has offered his ex-wife 1% of her £2.2 billion (approximately $30 billion) divorce demand. The case is being heard in a London court, where the ex-wife is pursuing a share of the fortune.
